AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  MARCH 16, 2021
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS
DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-
6833; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM. THE MEETING MAY BE
VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  5:30 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957(a):
  THREAT TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles
  County Sheriff representative, and other related City officials.

  II.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION  PURSUANT  TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE §54956.9(d)(4) – Initiation of litigation in one case.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  Mayor Perez

FLAG SALUTE
  Councilmember Ana Valencia

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS

  I.  City Council to proclaim March as Red Cross Month in the City of Norwalk.

  II.  City Council to proclaim March as Women’s History Month in the City of Norwalk.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  COVID-19 Update.

  2.  State of the City Preview.

  3.  Athens presentation.

  4.  Local Hazard Mitigation Plan Update.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.
   1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES ON THE AGENDA - Staff recommends City Council
  waive reading in full of all ordinances on the agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the
  public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further reading waived.

  2.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of March 9
  and 16, 2021. 825-04

  Minutes

  3.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period February 7, 2021 –
  February 20, 2021, in the total amount of $893,911.77. 630

  Report

  4.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  February 25, 2021 through March 10, 2021, in the total amount of $1,290,405.31. 640

  Warrant Register

  5.  RESOLUTION NO. 21-09 - DESTRUCTION OF OBSOLETE RECORDS - Staff recommends City
  Council adopt Resolution No. 21-09, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING THE DESTRUCTION OF CERTAIN RECORDS IN THE CITY CLERK,
  PUBLIC SAFETY, AND PUBLIC SERVICES DEPARTMENTS. 870-02

  Report

  6.  ORDINANCE NO. 21-1723 - CHANGING THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL ELECTION DATE – Staff
  recommends City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 21-1723, AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK CHANGING THE DATE OF THE
  CITY’S GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION FROM THE FIRST TUESDAY AFTER THE FIRST
  MONDAY OF MARCH IN EVEN-NUMBERED YEARS TO THE FIRST TUESDAY AFTER THE FIRST
  MONDAY IN NOVEMBER IN EVEN-NUMBERED YEARS EFFECTIVE IN 2022 AND CONTINUING
  THEREAFTER. 845

  Report

  7.  THE 2020 NORWALK GENERAL PLAN AND HOUSING ELEMENT ANNUAL PROGRESS REPORT -
  Staff recommends City Council receive and file the 2020 General Plan and Housing Element Annual
  Progress Report, and direct staff to forward a copy of the report to the Governor’s Office of Planning
  and Research and the State Department of Housing and Community Development prior to April 1,
  2021.320-02

  Report

  8.  AGREEMENT AMENDMENT TO PROVIDE FINANCIAL AUDITING SERVICES - Staff recommends
  City Council authorize the City Manager to execute the one-year agreement amendment with
  CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP to perform the auditing services for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2021, on
  behalf of the City, on a form approved by the City Attorney. 606-01

  Report

  9.  RESOLUTION NO. 21-15 – AMENDING ADVISORY BODIES TERMS AND YOUTH COMMISSION
  APPOINTMENTS - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-15, A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 20-61,
  REGARDING ADVISORY BODY TERMS AND YOUTH COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS. 285

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  10. ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200 RESOLUTIONS
   Report

REPORTS

  11. PROJECT NO. 7924 - RESOLUTION NO. 21-10 – BUDGET AMENDMENT AND AWARD CONTRACT
  – CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL STREETS
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 24, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-07 – Staff
  recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 21-10, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE MEASURE “M” BOND PROCEEDS TO PROJECT NO.
  7924 - CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL STREETS
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 24 ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-07, in the
  amount of $1,436,811; and

  b.  award a contract to RJ Noble Company in the amount of $1,260,361.00 for Measure M funded
  Local Street Rehabilitation; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract and any
  amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney.
  610/1005-04-7924

  Report

  12. PROJECT NO. 7925 - RESOLUTION NO. 21-11 – BUDGET AMENDMENT AND AWARD CONTRACT
  – CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL STREETS
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 27, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-08 - Staff
  recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 21-11, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE MEASURE “R” BOND PROCEEDS TO PROJECT NO.
  7925 - CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL STREETS
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 27 ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-08, in the
  amount of $660,400; and

  b.  award a contract to RJ Noble Company in the amount of $579,280 for Measure R funded Zone 25
  Local Street Rehabilitation; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts and any
  amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney. 610/1005-04-7925

  Report

  13. PROJECT NO. 7926 - RESOLUTION NO. 21-12 – BUDGET AMENDMENT AND AWARD CONTRACT
  – CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL STREETS
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 32, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-09 – Staff
  recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 21-12, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE MEASURE “R” BOND PROCEEDS TO PROJECT NO.
  7926 - CONSTRUCTION AND STAFF ADMINISTRATION FOR LOCAL STREETS
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 32 ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-09, in the
  amount of $1,104,078.50; and

  b.  award a contract to RJ Noble Company in the amount of $968,488.50 for Measure R funded Local
  Street Rehabilitation; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts and any
  amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney.
  610/1005-04-7926

  Report

  14. RESOLUTION NO. 21-13 - BUDGET AMENDMENT AND AWARD CONTRACT FOR PROFESSIONAL
   ENGINEERING SERVICES - PREPARATION OF THE 2020 URBAN WATER MANAGEMENT PLAN
  UPDATE - Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 21-13, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE ENTERPRISE FUNDS FOR THE PREPARATION OF
  THE 2020 URBAN WATER MANAGEMENT PLAN UPDATE, in the amount of $39,900; and

  b.  award a contract to SA Associates, in the amount of $38,000 to provide professional engineering
  services for the preparation of the 2020 Urban Water Management Plan Update; and authorize the
  City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments, provided there is funding in the
  budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 610/1070-07

  Report

  15. RESOLUTION NO. 21-14 – BUDGET AMENDMENT AND AWARD CONTRACT FOR
  PROFESSIONAL ENGINEERING SERVICES - PREPARATION OF THE AMERICA’S WATER
  INFRASTRUCTURE ACT RISK AND RESILIENCY ASSESSMENT AND EMERGENCY RESPONSE
  PLAN – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 21-14, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE ENTERPRISE FUNDS FOR THE PREPARATION OF
  THE AMERICA’S WATER INFRASTRUCTURE ACT RISK AND RESILIENCY ASSESSMENT AND
  EMERGENCY RESPONSE PLAN, in the amount of $70,639; and

  b.  award a contract to Arcadis U.S. Inc., in the amount of $67,275 to provide professional engineering
  services for the preparation of the America’s Water Infrastructure Act Risk and Resiliency
  Assessment and Emergency Response Plan; and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  agreement and any amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in
  a form approved by the City Attorney. 610/310-02

  Report

  16. HEART OF NORWALK PLAN – CONSULTANT UPDATE – Staff recommends City Council receive and
  file this report. 325-03

  Report

  17. ADOPTION OF STRATEGIC PLAN - Staff recommends City Council adopt the Strategic Plan for
  2021. 152

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated March 12, 2021.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
